title: WirePing
description: The anonymous ping a site in declined mode `pings` sends instead of an event. Cookieless: no visitor or session id, no seq, nothing linkable across events. Its field list is frozen after counsel sign-off (08 G2): adding a field is a framework amendment, never a routine release. The collector adds the server-derived fields (country, device class, server timestamp) in the Pub/Sub message.

schema_version.description: The wire schema's major version: this file's.

event_id.description: Random per ping, for idempotent storage only; it links nothing across events.

path.description: The page's URL path, PII-scrubbed: no query string, no fragment.

referrer_host.description: The referrer's hostname alone, when there is a referrer.

Utm.description: The landing URL's UTM parameters, those present.
